title: Frostline
tagline: Read the cracks. Trust the ice.
blurb: Sweep a frozen lake at dawn. The cracks count the thin ice nearby; plant a flag where the water waits.
description: Minesweeper on a frozen lake at sunrise. Every step through the frost reveals clear ice, and the cracks etched in it count the thin patches around you. Plant ice-fishing flags over the danger, open the rest, and watch the frost melt outward as the sun climbs over the pines. Safe first step, optional guess-free boards checked by a solver, a daily lake that is the same for everyone, and best times for Shore ice, Open lake and Black ice.
